title: Ghostline
summary: Private pay-per-call channels for AI agents, with cumulative vouchers and one settlement. The October 23 recording runs five simulated browser calls and shows separate archived evidence; these clicks created no transaction. October 24 review of the creator’s recorded-runs page found a hosted Sapient run dated October 23 and CLI run dated October 22, each reporting five calls and a final settlement. Call counts come from service ledgers, not chain proof; the explorer availability labels are dated October 23 creator observations. The Sapient relay controls the test deposit and refund; browser voucher keys do not remove that custody. Requests, timing and fees remain visible. No wallet, relay payment or CLI was run here.
cardSummary: Explore payment channels that let AI agents pay per API call using cumulative vouchers and one settlement.
creator: AduAkorful
